Before filing, read
[`docs/kip/README.md`](../../docs/kip/README.md) and
[`GOVERNANCE.md` §6](../../docs/GOVERNANCE.md#6-kip-lifecycle)–[§8](../../docs/GOVERNANCE.md#8-kip-acceptance-criteria).
This issue represents the **Idea** stage of the KIP lifecycle; a full
Draft satisfying every section below is required before Discussion
begins.

## Category

One of: Language / Compiler / Runtime / Memory / Toolchain / Standard
Library / Documentation / Governance / Ecosystem / Package Manager (per
[`GOVERNANCE.md` §7](../../docs/GOVERNANCE.md#7-kip-categories)).

## Motivation

Why this problem is worth solving.

## Problem statement

The specific, concrete problem, ideally with a real or realistic example.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches, and why they were not chosen.

## Trade-offs

What this proposal gives up in exchange for what it gains.

## Backward compatibility

Whether, and how, this affects already-shipped behavior.

## Migration strategy

If not purely additive, how an existing project adapts.

## Security analysis

What new attack surface, if any, this introduces.

## Performance impact

Expected effect on compile time, generated code size, or runtime resource
cost, if any.
